sources.excerpt: 1937 children's fantasy set in Middle-earth. Bilbo, a hobbit, joins the wizard Gandalf and thirteen dwarves on a quest to reclaim treasure from a dragon; episodic, a new monster or threat in many chapters; personal growth is central; omniscient narrator. Many adaptations including screen.
